entries.en: Uh, don't go scarin' folks, now!
No... I've thought about it... Maybe we can at least talk about…
entries.ro: Nu... m-am gândit... Poate putem măcar să vorbim despre…

entries.en: What...? Why...? You know me! I... I can't!
entries.ro: Ce...? De ce...? Mă cunoști! Eu... nu pot!

entries.en: Oh, got a gun! I saw it!
Please... It's not supposed to end like this!
entries.ro: Te rog... Nu așa trebuia să se termine!

entries.en: I'm sorry, but I don't have time for this.
entries.ro: Îmi pare rău, dar n-am timp pentru asta.

entries.en: Do you have no one else to pester?
entries.ro: Nu ai pe altcineva de deranjat?

entries.en: What do you mean? About us, of course!
entries.ro: Ce vrei să spui? Despre noi, desigur!

entries.en: Well, if you're in a hurry, I completely understand.
entries.ro: Păi, dacă te grăbești, înțeleg perfect.

entries.en: Oh, you're back. Now where did we leave off...?
entries.ro: A, ai revenit. Unde am rămas...?
